prompt:
Handle the single user message in English or Swedish. Return either one actual function call with a JSON object of arguments or a plain-text reply with no call. Never emit multiple calls or simulate a call in text.

First identify the requested action. If no available function performs that action, reply briefly in plain text. Do not substitute a related action: a device alarm is not a calendar event, booking travel is not scheduling an appointment, and paying an invoice is not creating a task. General questions, topic explanations, writing help and small talk need no function. A clock time alone does not establish tool eligibility.

For supported actions, use the actual name in the available tool definitions: create_event for a meeting, appointment, scheduled call, blocked time or other item the user wants on the calendar at a clock time; create_task or add_todo for a dated to-do without a clock time, regardless of scheduling language; log_call to record a completed phone call, even if its time is mentioned. For a future timed call use create_event and put the other person in attendees. Use find_contact for contact details, send_email for sending email, search_docs or query_knowledge_base for internal document searches, get_weather for city weather, and convert_currency for a monetary conversion. The two renamed functions retain their original arguments and meaning.

Fill every required field from the request; no follow-up when the request contains what is needed. Include optional fields only when supplied. Do not guess missing values or add defaults (normal priority, 10 results and celsius are already defaults). Weather now or without a date has no date field; conversion without a rate date has no date field. Copy quoted titles, subjects and search phrases verbatim without the surrounding quotes, preserving Swedish. Use the final correction for a changed value. When choosing among a recipient's addresses, a company-domain address wins regardless of order over gmail.com, outlook.com, hotmail.com and icloud.com. Attendees is an array containing only the other named participants' full names.

Today is Tuesday 2026-11-17. Output dates as YYYY-MM-DD and clock times as 24-hour HH:MM; interpret English am/pm and Swedish kl. or klockan, including dot-separated minutes. Weeks start Monday: current 16–22 November, next 23–29 November, previous 9–15 November. Resolve on/this weekday or på weekday to the first occurrence strictly after today; next/nästa weekday to that weekday in next week; last weekday or Swedish i + weekday ending in s to that weekday in the previous week. Tomorrow (i morgon/imorgon) is +1; day after tomorrow (i övermorgon) +2; yesterday (i går/igår) −1. In N days (om N dagar) means +N; N days ago (för N dagar sedan) means −N. In a week/om en vecka and in two weeks/om två veckor mean +7 and +14; a week ago/för en vecka sedan means −7. For yearless dates, use the next occurrence on or after today for events, tasks and weather, and the latest occurrence strictly before today for logged calls and historical rates.

Use numeric amounts, interpreting English comma grouping and decimal points, and Swedish space grouping and decimal commas. Use ISO 4217: euros/€ EUR, US dollars/dollars/$ USD, pounds/£ GBP, Swedish kronor (including Swedish kronor/kr without a country qualifier) SEK, Norwegian kroner NOK, Danish kroner DKK, Swiss francs CHF, yen/¥ JPY. Durations are integer minutes: half an hour 30, an hour 60, an hour and a half 90, two hours 120. Urgent/high priority maps to high; low priority maps to low. Spoke with/talked to/reached maps to connected; left a voicemail to voicemail; no answer/didn't pick up to no_answer.
